mini_design_cds_moderate_gc_001.rationale: The CDS translates to MAKEL, has moderate GC, and avoids EcoRI/BamHI.

mini_repair_ecori_preserve_translation_0.rationale: GAGTTT still encodes EF but breaks the GAATTC EcoRI motif.

mini_nl_clone_ready_implicit_001.rationale: This CDS translates to MGAES and satisfies the clone-ready constraints.

mini_infeasible_gly_low_gc_001.rationale: Every glycine codon starts with GG, so a two-glycine CDS cannot have GC below 30 percent.

mini_pareto_cds_panel_001.rationale: C03 trades lower codon-preference proxy for a shorter homopolymer while staying feasible and Pareto-optimal.

mini_pareto_expression_panel_001.rationale: PR04 is feasible and Pareto-optimal: higher synthesis score than PR02 at the cost of being farther from target TIR.

mini_pareto_rbs_pair_001.rationale: RP03 is the feasible orthogonal pair with acceptable TIR bands and synthesis score.

mini_pareto_mini_protein_panel_001.rationale: P02 satisfies all property bands and is Pareto-optimal over pI closeness, GRAVY closeness, and molecular weight.
